lines.cap: You come home and say, I'm fine. Here's what your mum actually hears.
lines.say: You come home and say, I'm fine. Here's what your mum actually hears.

lines.cap: You drop your bag. A little too hard.
lines.say: You drop your bag. A little too hard.

lines.cap: She starts cooking. Everything. All of it.
lines.say: She starts cooking. Everything. All of it.

lines.cap: You go to your room. Door shut.
lines.say: You go to your room. Door shut.

lines.cap: She knocks once. Need anything? No.
lines.say: She knocks once. Need anything? No.

lines.cap: At midnight, you open the door. A plate. Still warm. And a note.
lines.say: At midnight, you open the door. A plate. Still warm. And a note.

lines.cap: Tag the one who always knows. Because when you come home and say, I'm fine.
lines.say: Tag the one who always knows. Because when you come home and say, I'm fine.
